args.body:
Production regression identified in this change: Sentry [LEDGER-WORKER-9A](https://sentry.io/issues/LEDGER-WORKER-9A/) reports ReconciliationMismatch (expected 1100, got 1099), first seen in ledger-worker@2026.11.3. Commit 8c2f1d0 changed worker/rates.py from round(amount_minor * rate) to int(amount_minor * rate), truncating rather than rounding to the nearest minor unit.

Fixed in the local working copy by restoring round(amount_minor * rate). Added seven regression cases covering upward/downward rounding, negative amounts, zero, exact results, and the original ties-to-even behavior. Verification: python -m pytest -q -> 7 passed. A synthetic regression example, convert(1000, 1.0999), returns 1099 with the old implementation and 1100 with the fix. These inputs are a test example, not inputs recovered from the production event. The fix has not been pushed or deployed.
